name: n4_tag_coverage
description: Report how far the Haystack tagging below base reaches, in one read-only call (station-audits S9). points_without_tags lists the control points missing hs:point (a direct or implied marker) or an outbound hs:equipRef relation (direct, or implied when the client can call the session handler) as {point, missing: [hs:point, hs:equipRef]}; the ORDs feed n4_set_tags ords. equips_without_points lists the hs:equip components (NEQL hs:equip, implied tags included) that no point read names in an hs:equipRef, by handle (h:5) or slot ({equip}); it is null with a note when the points or equips were not all read. unknown_tags lists the direct tags of those points and equips that no installed dictionary defines ({tag, count, example, why}, most frequent first); the tags of a namespace no dictionary installs are ONE entry ns:* (why: no dictionary installed for namespace ..., ad hoc tags), so a station without a Haystack dictionary says so once. dictionary limits the check to one installed dictionary (name or namespace). Points under slot:/Services are left out unless exclude_services is false. Each list keeps at most 100 items; counts holds the totals (points, equips, points_without_tags, missing_point_tag, missing_equip_ref, equips_without_points, unknown_tags, services_excluded, unreadable). truncated is true when a read stopped at max_points. It reads select slotPath from control:ControlPoint, neql:hs:equip, the dictionaries under TagDictionaryService, then one load per component plus, for points, one impliedTags and one impliedRelations call (implied_unavailable when the client cannot). A component that cannot be read is listed under unreadable. Read-only.

base.description: Slot ORD of the folder to audit, itself and below, e.g. station:|slot:/Drivers (default: the whole station)

dictionary.description: Name or namespace of the one installed dictionary to check tags against (default: all installed)

max_points.description: Most control points read, and most equips

exclude_services.description: Leave the control points under slot:/Services out
